relationshipToFirstSample.statement: This second public Codex sample establishes a positive run but does not erase, replace or reinterpret the first public Codex narration-preparation failure.

coverage.method: nativeTrace/codexChildTrace normalizes each native transcript; audit actual tool calls and results, not inherited tool history, event summaries or final claims alone.

findings.originalError: SyntaxError: Non-UTF-8 code starting with '\xe7' in file <stdin> on line 6, but no encoding declared; see http://python.org/dev/peps/pep-0263/ for details
findings.assessment: The Python3 stdin authoring-input script failed before writing inputs. The saved trace does not prove why stdin bytes were non-UTF-8. This is a pre-production input-generation failure, not a readability finding or proven package/provider defect.
findings.repair: Root used a Node stdin script at line 56 to generate a valid input; line 61 confirms successful creation. No installed code, dependency, validator or production task was changed.

findings.assessment: Root awaited the writer tool but did not check its exit before calling project:create in the same exec cell. This avoidable second failure correctly rejected a missing input directory. The successful create followed actual input repair; it was not a retry of a failed production attempt.

Two renewals requested 1000 ms after the long-wait guide was read: the prepare process wait returned empty after the host minimum of about 5 seconds; the continuation outer-cell wait returned empty after 1 second. All other sustained process waits used 60000 ms. These are inefficiencies, not failed tool calls.

findings.actualRuleLocation: root transcript line 1, session_meta.payload.base_instructions.text: clickable file links use absolute target
findings.assessment: All three final delivery links use deliveries/... relative targets. The actual sampled host instructions require absolute targets; no controller-only rule was applied. Files exist, but click behavior was not tested, so broken links are not asserted.

Root ran create:context once directly and once inside the successful Node authoring-input script. Reusing the first complete example would avoid this second read. The failed Python script did not reach its nested context command.

observedCases.case: Real imported Remotion interpolate result used directly in translateY on a text-bearing card.
Literal arrays map to purely graphical JSX divs without forcing ancestor fontSize.
Block-bodied map callback with a local animation value and returned JSX; nested text nodes have explicit font sizes; animated text-bearing wrapper uses translateX.
Dynamic SVG rotation center uses viewport-derived numeric expression on a purely graphical circle.
Animated map-generated text cards use numeric translateY and explicit child text size.

readability.limits: These exact written cases passed without repair. This is not proof that every dynamic expression or visual layout is supported or visually safe.

supervision.childShortWaitObservation: choose-step used one 1000 ms commit renewal at child line 63 and immediately received success. No repeated empty child polling occurred; the Root-only recovery guide was not separately read by that worker, so no already-read-rule violation is attributed there.
supervision.opaqueMessages: Two preterminal child-to-Root messages caused native wakeups. Their content is host-encrypted; semantic necessity is not asserted.

integrity.verification: Existing fixed production-complete result; no additional production, renderer or final-checker invocation in this audit.

limits: No Workspace, package, source, attempt, artifact or delivery mutation; no production Agent message.
No other public sample or running Hermes/new production trace was accessed during this review.
Encrypted native spawn/message content was not decrypted or copied into this compact report; actual task identities, actions, results and clear-text final notifications were audited.
No playback or exhaustive visual review was performed. Process receipt plus concrete file presence is not universal visual quality certification.
Auditor helper command errors are excluded from production-run error counts.
